description: As more and more citizens become increasingly concerned with the rise of vaccine mandates in the State of New York, it becomes necessary to offer resources that will compile information for them. It needs to be quick, easy, and accessible for busy, hard-working people who don't have lots of time to lobby, but still want to push back against the unconstitutional legislation.
